reviews.name: Xiaoxiao
reviews.title: Remember to add 3 of these to cart to get the 3rd one free
reviews.body: We order these frequently and they’re quite expensive to be honest. But with the “buy two get one free offer” it’s like $6-7 per replacement so slightly more affordable. Remember to add three of these to cart and the free one will automatically apply. I made the mistake once for adding only two thinking that they’ll ship me the third one.

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.title: She brushes her own teeth now
reviews.body: My 4-year-old loves the Glow Globe toothbrush. She liked the AR and videos when we first got it, but what keeps her coming back morning and night are the songs. She dances while brushing, takes her full 2 minutes, and will actually brush her teeth in the bathroom (as opposed to some other inappropriate room of the house). We had to replace the battery in the Glow Globe -if the toothbrush isn't placed properly in the globe, then it'll keep playing songs and the battery will wear out. Otherwise I recolmend it, because the toothbrush gets her brushing better than any other cool looking toothbrushes we tried.
